# @nova-caelum/ui — compiled build

This folder is a compiled build of `@nova-caelum/ui`, Nova Caelum's design system, included only so this demo
builds from a fresh clone. It holds the package's built JavaScript, type declarations and styles (`dist/`) and the
Caelos brand artwork (`assets/caelos/`); its source is not part of this repository.
